entities.summary: Albert Louis Hammond Jr. is an American-British musician who is a member of the rock band the Strokes. He is best known for his role as rhythm and lead guitarist, as well as occasionally a keyboard player and backing vocalist for the band. Hammond has released extensive solo work, including five solo albums.
